## What's new
- New Tables tab to view and assign each guest's table.
- Assignments save to your seating sheet, so the 'Find your table' page updates right away.
- Search guests, browse all tables, and select several guests to seat them together.
- New button that opens the 'Find your table' guest page.

## Setup
Open Settings > Connections and enter the seating web app URL and admin key under 'Seating backend'.
